conditions: Valid while LT-3003 is in service and LAH-3003 is not shelved or suppressed.
rationale: SIF-300-01 trips at 1500 mm on LT-3002A/B/C. LT-3003 is the BPCS DP transmitter on the same vessel, a separate transmitter on a separate system; LAH-3003 at 1200 mm annunciates before the trip point. Not credited in the LOPA only because the initiating loop uses LT-3003.

conditions: Valid while LT-3003 is in service and LAL-3003 is not shelved.
rationale: SIF-300-02 trips at 150 mm on LT-3005. LAL-3003 at 400 mm is taken from the BPCS transmitter LT-3003 and annunciates before the trip point.

conditions: Valid while PT-3013 is in service and PAH-3013 is not shelved.
rationale: SIF-300-03 trips at 82 barg on PT-3012A/B/C. PT-3013 is a BPCS transmitter with its own tapping downstream of E-301; PAH-3013 at 76 barg annunciates before the trip point.

conditions: Valid while TT-3015 is in service and TAH-3015 is not shelved.
rationale: SIF-300-04 trips at 175 degC on TT-3014A/B. TAH-3015 at 160 degC is taken from the BPCS transmitter TT-3015 in its own thermowell.

conditions: Valid while PT-3021 is in service and PAL-3021 is not shelved.
rationale: SIF-300-05 trips at 0.8 barg on PT-3020A/B/C. PT-3021 is the BPCS transmitter on the lube oil header; PAL-3021 at 1.5 barg annunciates before the trip point.

conditions: Valid while PT-3006 is in service and PAL-3006 is not shelved.
rationale: SIF-300-06 trips at 15 barg on PT-3007A/B. PAL-3006 at 18 barg is taken from the BPCS transmitter PT-3006, independent of the SIS transmitters.
